CALLER STATED HER DAUGHTER WAS NOT FEELING WELL. CALLER STATED THERE WAS SKIN IRRITATION AS WELL AS STOMACH SICKNESS. CALLER STATED THE NEXT DAY WHEN THEY USED THE POOL SHE NOTICED HER DAUGHTER'S BATHING SUIT CHANGED COLORS FROM PINK TO PURPLE. CALLER STATED HER DAUGHTER WAS EXPOSED TO THE HIGH LEVEL OF CHLORINE IN THE POOL AREA. CALLER STATED THE LEVEL OF CHEMICALS IN THE POOL AT NORMAL LEVEL IS 3.5 BUT THE LEVEL REGISTERED AT 10.0 DURING THIS INCIDENT. CALLER STATED HER DAUGHTER HAS A PRODUCTIVE COUGH AND FEVER. CALLER STATED A MEDICAL APPOINTMENT IS SET FOR TODAY AT 1500 HOURS TO HAVE HER DAUGHTER CHECK BY A DOCTOR.
